posts.title: Moorhen
posts.description: A moorhen stands in the shallow water of the autumnal pond in Schlosspark Bochum-Weitmar, surrounded by yellow willow leaves and reflections. I was up rather early today and thought it might be nice to go for a short walk before the day got going. posts.title: A coot is reflected in the water
posts.description: A coot makes its way through the water, its reflection visible on the water’s surface.

posts.title: A coot searches for food
posts.description: A coot is searching for food in a meadow by the water, amongst the yellow and brown autumn leaves. It is holding a few blades of grass in its beak.
